item.title: pgvector 0.8.0 Is Here: Do You Still Need a Dedicated Vector Database?
item.description: Your CTO approved a $50k Pinecone contract. An intern added vector search to your existing PostgreSQL for free in 47 minutes. pgvector 0.8.0's iterative scans and smart query planning make dedicated vector databases unnecessary for most use cases
